name: Mazane Hitoka
source:
Area: Tottori Prefecture

A detective with a weak personality who runs a detective business all by herself. Hitoka often tries motivating herself by saying "The truth is always alone!".

She hasn't done any big cases and mainly helps out with finding lost animals so she's worried about her future, and has said that she'll do anything in exchange for money.
